rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.78% (15.13% vs 13.35%).
Beat the benchmark in 82.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Large Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.94 vs benchmark 0.75, Sortino 1.18.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 3.99% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.91).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-33.43% vs -33.70%).
Rolling return range spans 11.40% to 20.15% (8.75 pp spread) — consistency score 89.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
